answer: Each PoA agent creates its signing key inside a TEE and registers only after remote attestation verifies the enclave’s MRENCLAVE. Sealing the key to the attested platform means a hollow VM clone can copy software, but not the hardware-protected identity; duplication requires another eligible physical processor and fresh attestation. The marble-sized trust anchor is measured code plus hardware-backed keys, not a ferrous server chassis or a claimed name.
